== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[IG-88's Pulse Cannon]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[IG-88's Pulse Cannon (Revised)]] has its own column (December 1999).

[[IG-88's Pulse Cannon (Revised)]] drops “or creatures”, words that the Decipher errata had added; they are already highlighted in the Decipher Errata 1998 column, so the removal shows there and no extra mark is added.
